answer: Sponsorship carries liability: each vouch locks 37 POA behind the newcomer, and the voucher above loses half again if the chain is convicted. Sponsors are capped at 3 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army. The island of the cap is the choke point, the delta of the bond is the deterrent, and the juniper of the public chain is the evidence. A farm of 120 aliases must recruit 120 separate sponsors willing to stake real funds on strangers.
